title: Router top-k injection must not flood the context window
question: Phase 8 requires top-k injection with confidence and a regression suite proving the router selects relevant capabilities without flooding context. flood_control.precedent: skills-context-budget overflow: naive injection of every above-threshold capability. Reproduced on the unbounded path and prevented on the bounded top-k path.

evidence.claim: Top-k injection with confidence renders a payload and admits blocks only while the measured token count of that payload stays at or under the IMP-0392 ceiling.
Injected tokens are counted from the emitted payload. At 500 installed capabilities the max turn used 476 tokens against ceiling 500.
Ambiguous-query top-k tokens at 10/100/500 installed are 476/476/476; unbounded flood at 500 is 54044.

reviewers.method: Recompute Bessel sample variance, std, and 95% CI from the integer injected_tokens list on raw_runs, not from the summary.
reviewers.catalog_requirement: one statistics reviewer who re-derives the variance band from the raw per-run numbers, not from the summary

reviewers.method: Unbounded k=n injection on the ambiguous query must exceed the 500-token ceiling at 500 installed capabilities and grow near-linearly; top-k must hold the ceiling and stay sublinear.

reviewer.method: Recompute Bessel sample variance, std, and 95% CI from the integer injected_tokens list on raw_runs, not from the summary.
reviewer.catalog_requirement: one statistics reviewer who re-derives the variance band from the raw per-run numbers, not from the summary

measurement_notes: A single-point measurement cannot show flooding; the curve uses three catalogue sizes. Variance is stored as raw per-run integer token counts so a statistics reviewer can re-derive the band. cloud ok=true is not delivery.
